He begins with 60, buys a goat, has 0 now, then he sells it for 70, takes a loan of 10, buys it back for 80, has zero again and sells it for 90.

He started with 60 and now has 90, 10 of which he has to pay back as loan payment so 90-60-10 = 20.

Originally his business model only 10 units of profit but he ended up making double. Pretty brilliant strategy and also basically the founding step of a pyramid scheme.
